rule-based-v1.description: Deterministic weighted risk scoring engine: nine normalised features with fixed weights. Transparent baseline, always available.

rf-v1.description: Random Forest classifier (300 trees) trained on live database flood records: 52 documented flood events plus 36 synthetic non-flood observations across 12 districts.
rf-v1.caveat: Small training set (88 rows) with a synthetic negative class; metrics are optimistic and will improve as real non-flood observations are added.

randomforest-v1.description: Random Forest classifier (300 trees, class_weight=balanced) trained on the Sindh 2010-2024 district-year research dataset: 180 rows, 43 flood years, ERA5 monsoon weather + static district attributes.
randomforest-v1.caveat: 180 district-year rows, 43 flood years (23.9% positive). Negative class = no documented flood (reporting bias); metrics are honest but the sample is modest.

randomforest.description: Alias for randomforest-v1: Random Forest classifier (300 trees, class_weight=balanced) trained on the Sindh 2010-2024 district-year research dataset: 180 rows, 43 flood years, ERA5 monsoon weather + static district attributes.

xgboost-v1.description: XGBoost gradient-boosted trees (300 rounds, max_depth=6, lr=0.05) trained on the Sindh 2010-2024 district-year research dataset.
xgboost-v1.caveat: 180 district-year rows, 43 flood years (23.9% positive). Negative class = no documented flood (reporting bias); metrics are honest but the sample is modest.

xgboost.description: Alias for xgboost-v1: XGBoost gradient-boosted trees (300 rounds, max_depth=6, lr=0.05) trained on the Sindh 2010-2024 district-year research dataset.

mlp-v1.description: Multi-layer perceptron (64-32 hidden units, max_iter=800) trained on the Sindh 2010-2024 district-year research dataset. Feature importance via permutation importance (10 repeats) on the held-out test set.
mlp-v1.caveat: 180 district-year rows, 43 flood years (23.9% positive). Negative class = no documented flood (reporting bias); metrics are honest but the sample is modest.

mlp.description: Alias for mlp-v1: Multi-layer perceptron (64-32 hidden units, max_iter=800) trained on the Sindh 2010-2024 district-year research dataset. Feature importance via permutation importance (10 repeats) on the held-out test set.
